name: 19025 · Dresher, PA
findings: ZIP 19025 (Dresher) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19025 (Dresher) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
